reason: Every entry is done or cannot-occur. commitChecked still names 61dde4a, the slice's own commit, and the audit-fix commit that follows the correctness pass over 856b9f69..de2a8b5 does change code a pass would read, so a later prepare will ask for its own readiness run rather than accepting this one. The production game executes every done path: scripts/run-options-menu.mjs matches C over 14 recipes at 42,605 random-number calls, 224 screens and 224 cursors, and its new recipe 'remembered pile repainted by a glyph reset' walks the hero out of sight of a dropped pile before toggling hilite_pile, which is the case the reverted attempt at 0f7b6cf would have failed. The development session seed0006 reaches the same code at step 64 and gains the five screens the goal forecast. The two cannot-occur entries stop on a condition rather than on a hope: a hallucinated object's glyph number lands in the monster ranges, which map_glyphinfo() does not resolve, and any rogue level stops earlier at reglyph_darkroom()'s refusal, whose third gate term is Is_rogue_level().

boundary.startingEvent: The player picks a boolean row from doset_simple()'s menu whose optfn arm sets go.opt_need_glyph_reset. seed0006-wizard-water-demon reaches it at step 64, byte 'f' on page 2, which is hilite_pile.
boundary.endingEvent: The screen the port draws after reset_needed_visuals() returns, that is after display.c reset_glyphmap(gm_optionchange) has rebuilt the object ranges and the docrt() at options.c:9002 has repainted the map through them.
boundary.validInputs: The seven boolean rows sharing options.c:5379-5385 -- wizmgender, showrace, use_inverse, hilite_pile, perm_invent, ascii_map, tiled_map -- picked from doset_simple() or doset(). Of those, use_inverse now raises its own refusal, and only hilite_pile and showrace have a simple-menu row. Configuration families that reach the object arms: hilite_pile on or off, use_inverse on or off, and a level holding at least one object, corpse, statue or pile.
boundary.observables: levl[x][y].glyph as an unresolved glyph number in map memory rather than a resolved presentation; the MG_OBJPILE glyphflag; the character, colour and attribute the repaint prints for every remembered out-of-sight object square; the screens and cursor positions of the menu and the repaint; and the absence of any new random-number call, since none of the ported arms consumes randomness outside the Hallucination branch.
boundary.exclusions: The terrain layer -- display.c back_to_glyph() and reset_glyphmap()'s cmap, altar and wall-set arms -- which stays behind the 'color' and 'use_inverse' refusals and belongs to a later slice. Also excluded: reset_customcolors() and reset_customsymbols(), whose sibling refusals stay; reglyph_darkroom() over a dark_room change, which keeps its own refusal; and the monster, pet, detected-monster, invisible, ridden, swallow, explosion, zap and warning arms of reset_glyphmap(), none of which reaches map memory, since newsym() never records a monster presentation there.

candidateListMethod.dispatchTablesAndCatalogs: include/display.h enum glyph_offsets (497-547) and the object-glyph macros at 638 and 932-968. The enum's inputs were checked one by one against js/: NUMMONS, NUM_OBJECTS, MAXTCHARS, MAXEXPCHARS, WARNCOUNT, S_vwall, S_ndoor, S_grave, S_arrow_trap, S_trwall and S_brdnladder all resolved already; NUM_ZAP, S_digbeam and S_goodpos did not, and scripts/generate-glyph-offsets.mjs now supplies them into js/glyph_offsets.js under the check:glyph-offsets regeneration check.
candidateListMethod.reachableHelpers: reset_glyphmap()'s arm chain descends by offset, so the object arms are not contiguous. Reading the whole chain found eight, not the six first reported: the four piletop arms sit high in the chain and GLYPH_OBJ_OFF at 2968 and GLYPH_BODY_OFF at 3004 sit below every cmap arm. Purity was confirmed by reading rather than by name: obj_to_glyph() and statue_to_glyph() both take an rng argument and call random_object(), random_monster() or rng(2) under Hallucination, so they are not pure under AGENTS.md; there is no body_to_glyph(), only corpse_to_glyph().
candidateListMethod.javascriptCrossCheck: grep -rn 'UnsupportedOptionMenuError|reset_glyphmap|reglyph_darkroom' js/ found the refusal at js/options.js:4856 and the sibling one in reglyph_darkroom(). grep -n 'ATR_INVERSE' js/display.js found the five draw-time bakes. grep -rln 'remembered_glyph' js/ found six files, not the two first reported: js/display.js, js/lock.js, js/detect.js, js/game.js, js/options.js and js/startup_a11y.js. grep -n 'outsideTheLimit' scripts/run-options-menu.mjs found the marked matrix entry and the filter that skips it.
candidateListMethod.remainingLimits: Two remain. The rogue-level terms are excluded by a refusal rather than by a check against the 33 development sessions, so the exclusion is sound for the running game but the session-level claim is untested. And map_glyphinfo() raises a TypeError rather than a named refusal for a glyph number outside the object ranges; nothing today can hand it one, because only object squares store a number, but the guard is not the shape the port uses elsewhere.

sourceReview: Traced in two passes. The orchestrator traced the candidate list at e310ec0 before implementation, reading include/display.h's enum glyph_offsets and object-glyph macros, src/display.c reset_glyphmap()'s arm chain and closing clamp, win/tty/wintty.c:3919-3937, and the JavaScript refusal, stand-in, consumer and recipe sites; that reading corrected three claims from the slice-selector's report, which the checklist opened with. The worker traced the same range while implementing and corrected two more: the slice-selector's judgment that ATR_INVERSE sites 690 and 1766 were safe was wrong, since tty_print_glyph() gates the four MG_BW_* bits on iflags.use_inverse, which is why a use_inverse refusal now exists; and site 910 needed no change, because js/detect.js writes mappedSearchLayer() rather than a monster presentation. Both corrections were verified against source by the orchestrator at 61dde4a. The trace covered state and random-number order: no ported arm consumes randomness, and the two arms that do -- the Hallucination arms of obj_to_glyph() and statue_to_glyph() -- were left unchanged and are excluded by their monster-range result. Stubs, stops and partial implementations were identified: three refusals stand inside the boundary's neighbourhood ('color', 'use_inverse', and reglyph_darkroom() over a dark_room change), each stopping before any state change, random-number call or output, and map_glyphinfo() raises a TypeError for a glyph number outside the object ranges, which nothing can currently produce. 54 of 54 first-wave mutants over the slice's own lines were killed at kind=boolean,logical,relational, recorded in the slice's Mutants: trailer.
